title: console UX walk-through (showcase, pin 12dc7b47c340): 15 smaller UI defects — app-not-found dead end, one-letter lookup badges, dark-mode chart axes, no skip link, Studio copy and unbound labels
body:
Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defects, folded into one card per this session's quota (one walk-through, two separate cards filed, the rest listed here). Reader: the objectui dev seat that takes this card from the pm-dispatch queue; each item is small and independent, and can be split into its own card or fixed item by item. Dedupe: objectui issues, open+closed, one semantic query per item before filing — "app can't be opened not found screen no way back home chrome-less" (2 hits: #12305, #4473), "app not found verdict screen Retry only missing Back to home link" (0), "lookup picker option preview badge truncated" (4 hits: #11814, #11889, #9074, #2125), "chart axis tick label color dark mode contrast #666" (4 hits: #12375, #11681, #7386, #8246), "skip to main content link keyboard sidebar tab order" (8 hits, top: #12795, #12744, #12429, #12427, #11395); none of them covers an item below. The wave's other cards (#13052 #13054 #13055 #13056 #13061 #13062 #13063, objectstack#24576) were read first, and nothing below repeats them.

reach (all items): stock showcase with --seed-admin, framework 54159fd742e5, console pin objectui@12dc7b47c340, dist stamp equal to the pin, Chromium at 1440x900 unless stated. Each item was re-checked against objectui main df943a2a1af3 source before filing.

1. App "can't be opened" screen is a dead end.
   Where: open /_console/apps/com.objectstack.studio (an app id the server does not return, e.g. a stale bookmark or an uninstalled app).
   Actual: full-screen "This app can't be opened / The server did not return this app for your account." with only a Retry button — no app bar, no Back to home, no link anywhere. Expected: the same way out the access-denied screen already offers (its "Back to home" button), on the not_found / unreachable / not-available verdicts too.
   Source: packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx — the `requestedAppMissing` branch's `verdictScreen` renders Empty + Retry only; `renderAppAccessDenied` has the home button.

2. Lookup picker: select badges in the option preview are cut to one letter.
   Where: Showcase → Projects → New → Account → open the picker.
   Actual: each option's preview line reads "Lifecycle: A. · Industry: Tec... · Annual Revenue: $96,00..." — the badge for Active is "A.", Prospect is "P...", Healthcare "He...". Expected: a badge either shows its whole label or the preview drops it; a one-letter badge is unreadable.
   Source: packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx — `previewOf`: every preview column is a `min-w-0 truncate` span, so the badges rendered by renderLookupColumnValue shrink to their first glyph.

3. Import wizard: the finished step still says "Review data before importing."
   Where: Showcase → Tasks → Import → upload a CSV → Next → Import.
   Actual: under "Import Complete / 1 created / 1 skipped" the dialog subtitle is still "Review data before importing.". Expected: a subtitle that matches the done state (or none).
   Source: packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx — the DialogDescription falls through to `grid.import.previewDescription` on the result step.

4. Studio "Pending changes": fields listed by API name, internal field shown.
   Where: Studio → a new object with a field "Visit Date" → Publish.
   Actual: the object's rows read "+ __search, + created_at, + created_by, + name, … + visit_date", then "Also changed: + label, + name, + nameField, + sharingModel". Expected: field rows lead with the field label (as the item row already does since objectui#11862), and the internal `__search` field is not listed as an author change.
   Source: packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx — `fields.added.map` prints `+ {name}` only.

5. Studio New Package dialog uses the retired word "project".
   Where: Studio → "New package (writable base)".
   Actual: "Create a project-scoped package to author and publish your own metadata." Expected: the current term (environment), or no scope word. ObjectStack renamed project → environment in v5 (ADR-0006).
   Source: packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts — `engine.packages.create.description`.

6. Studio Data rail: empty text points to a control that is not there.
   Where: Studio → a package with no objects → left rail.
   Actual: "No objects yet — create one below to start", but the rail's only create control is the + above it. Expected: wording that matches the layout ("Use + to create one").
   Source: packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts — `engine.studio.data.noObjects`.

7. Studio New object dialog: labels are not bound to their inputs.
   Where: Studio → New object.
   Actual: "Object name" and "Identifier" are label elements with no htmlFor, and the inputs carry no id or aria-label, so a screen reader announces two unlabeled edit fields (Playwright getByLabel('Object name') finds nothing). Expected: each label bound to its input.
   Source: packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx — the create-object dialog (next to the `create-object-owd` select).

8. Dark mode: dashboard chart axis labels are hard to read.
   Where: any dashboard (Showcase → Analytics → Delivery Operations) with the OS in dark mode.
   Actual: axis tick text has fill #666 (computed) on the dark card, about 3:1, under the 4.5:1 needed for 12 px text; the category labels (Green / Yellow / Red, Backlog / To Do …) are the hard ones to read. Expected: ticks use the theme's muted-foreground, as the simple chart already does.
   Source: packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx — XAxis / YAxis pass no `tick` fill, so recharts' default #666 applies; packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartImpl.tsx sets `fill: 'hsl(var(--muted-foreground))'`.

9. Keyboard: about 60 Tab presses to reach a list's New button.
   Where: Showcase → Contacts, keyboard only from page load.
   Actual: the focus order walks the app bar, then every sidebar item twice (the link and its "More actions for …" button), so "New" is about the 60th stop; there is no skip link. In the opened Create/Edit dialogs the first focus is the Close button, not the first field. Expected: a "Skip to content" link as the first stop, and dialog focus on the first editable field. Saving a new record by keyboard does work once you get there.
   Source: no skip link anywhere in packages/app-shell, packages/layout or apps/console (grep "Skip to" finds nothing); sidebar items are in packages/app-shell's sidebar nav (`sidebar-item-menu-trigger`).

10. zh-CN: untranslated word in the Studio home.
    Where: switch to 中文（中国） → Studio home.
    Actual: "新建软件包(可写 base)". Expected: fully translated text (for example 新建软件包(可写基础包)).
    Source: packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts — zh `engine.studio.pkg.new`.

11. Inbox popover: "1 notifications".
    Where: bell → Inbox header.
    Actual: "4 total · 1 notifications + 3 pending approvals", while the one group row under it reads "×3 · 3 unread". Expected: singular for one ("1 notification"); the plural forms exist for approvalsPending but not for this key.
    Source: packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts — `inbox.badgeNotifications: '{{unread}} notifications'` has no _one / _other forms (the variable is not `count`, so i18next pluralization never runs).

12. Phone width (390x844): the mobile "+" button covers the last card.
    Where: Showcase → Projects at 390x844.
    Actual: the floating create button sits on top of the last card's Account value and Health badge (Legacy Sunset: "Northwind", "Green"), and the list has no bottom space to scroll it clear. Expected: list bottom padding at least the button's height.
    Source: packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx — `mobile-fab-create`.

13. Flow header text is clipped mid-word.
    Where: Studio → Automations → a new record-triggered flow, with the Properties panel open at 1440.
    Actual: the header meta ends "… · Status: Unpublis" — cut mid-word, no ellipsis or tooltip. Expected: the meta wraps or ellipsizes with the full text available on hover.
    Source: packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowPreview.tsx — `FlowMetaPills` header variant (`inline-flex min-w-0`).

14. Home "unpublished changes" banner names the package by its id.
    Where: Home after leaving drafts in a Studio package.
    Actual: "2 unpublished changes · Visit Created, Visit Readers waiting to publish in com.default.ux-walk-pkg" (zh-CN: "在 com.default.ux-walk-pkg 包里等待发布"). Expected: the package's label (UX Walk Pkg), which Studio itself shows.
    Source: packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomeRail.tsx — `home.pendingDrafts.inPackage`.

15. One surface, three names.
    Where: Home button "Build an app" → breadcrumb "Studio" → page title "App Builder".
    Expected: one name for the surface across the entry point, breadcrumb and title.
    Source: packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts and the home hero (packages/app-shell/src/console/home).

type: Bug
